name: glastyn

attributes.attribute: a form of the spectral water horse
lived on the Isle of Man

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The glastyn, also spelled glashtin, is a Manx folkloric figure. This form of the spectral water horse dwelt on the Isle of Man. He appeared as a handsome man rather than a horse. He belongs to the wider family of Celtic water horses found across the islands.
